sentences.en: DIRECTOR: Good morning
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 早上好。

sentences.en: Welcome to the Early Learning Childcare Centre
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到早期学习儿童保育中心。

sentences.en: How may I help you?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: CAROL: Hi
sentences.zh: CAROL: 你好。

sentences.en: I spoke to you last week about enrolling my daughter for next year
sentences.zh: 我上周跟您联系过，想为我女儿报名明年入学。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: Oh, yes
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I'll just get some details from you
sentences.zh: 我来为您登记一些详细信息。

sentences.en: So, you're her mother?
sentences.zh: 那么，您是她的母亲吗？

sentences.en: CAROL: That's right
sentences.zh: CAROL: 没错。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: And, can I have your name?
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 能告诉我您的姓名吗？

sentences.en: CAROL: It's Carol, Carol Smith
sentences.zh: CAROL: 我叫卡罗尔，卡罗尔·史密斯。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: And your daughter's name?
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 那您女儿的名字呢？

sentences.en: CAROL: It's Kate
sentences.zh: CAROL: 她叫凯特。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: Now, we have several groups at the centre and we cater for children from three to five years old
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 目前中心设有多个班级，面向三至五岁的儿童。

sentences.en: How old iS your daughter?
sentences.zh: 您女儿多大了？

sentences.en: CAROL: She's three now but she turns four next month
sentences.zh: CAROL: 她现在三岁，但下个月就满四岁了。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: I'll put four down because that's how old she'll be when she starts
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 我会登记为四岁，因为这是她入学时的年龄。

sentences.en: CAROL: Fine, she's so excited about her birthday and coming to the centre
sentences.zh: CAROL: 好的，她对生日和来中心都特别兴奋。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: That's good to hear
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 很高兴听到这个消息。

sentences.en: And what's your address?
sentences.zh: 您的地址是？

sentences.en: CAROL: It's 46 Wombat Road, that's W-O-M-B-A-T
sentences.zh: CAROL: 地址是袋鼠路46号，拼写是W-O-M-B-A-T。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: And what's the phone number?
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 电话号码是多少？

sentences.en: CAROL: Oh ... it's 3345 9865
DIRECTOR: So, have you decided on the days you'd like to bring your daughter here?
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 那么，您是否已确定希望带女儿来中心的具体日期？

sentences.en: CAROL: I'd prefer Monday and Wednesday if possible
sentences.zh: CAROL: 如果可能的话，我更倾向于周一和周三。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: Mmm
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'll check, Monday's fine, but think the centre is already full for Wednesday
sentences.zh: 我来查一下——周一没问题，但周三中心似乎已经满员了。

sentences.en: Erm
sentences.zh: 呃。

sentences.en: Yes
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Sorry
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: It seems to be a very popular day
sentences.zh: 看来周三是非常热门的一天。

sentences.en: We can offer you a Thursday or a Friday as well
sentences.zh: 我们也可以为您提供周四或周五。

sentences.en: CAROL: Oh dear
sentences.zh: CAROL: 哎呀。

sentences.en: I suppose Thursday would be all right because she has swimming on Friday
sentences.zh: 我想周四应该可以，因为她周五要上游泳课。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: OK, got that
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 好的，已记录。

sentences.en: Because a lot of parents work, we do offer flexible start and finish times
sentences.zh: 由于许多家长需要工作，我们提供灵活的上下课时间。

sentences.en: We are open from 7:30 in the morning until 6 o'clock at night
sentences.zh: 中心每天早上7:30开放，晚上6:00关闭。

sentences.en: What time would you like your daughter to start?
sentences.zh: 您希望女儿几点开始上课？

sentences.en: CAROL: I need to get to work in the city by 9:00 so I'll drop her off at 8:30
sentences.zh: CAROL: 我需要在9:00前赶到市区上班，所以我会在8:30送她过去。

sentences.en: You're pretty close to the city here so that should give me plenty of time to get there
sentences.zh: 你们这儿离市区很近，这样我应该有充足的时间赶到那里。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: That's fine
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 没问题。

sentences.en: Now, we also need to decide which group she'll be in
sentences.zh: 现在，我们还需要决定她将被分入哪个组。

sentences.en: We have two different groups and they're divided up according to age
sentences.zh: 我们有两个不同的组，按年龄划分。

sentences.en: There's the green group, which is for three- to four-year-olds
sentences.zh: 一个是绿色组，面向三至四岁的孩子。

sentences.en: And then there's the red group which is for four- to five-year-olds
sentences.zh: 另一个是红色组，面向四至五岁的孩子。

sentences.en: CAROL: She's quite mature for her age and she can already write her name and read a little
sentences.zh: CAROL: 她比同龄孩子要成熟得多，已经会写自己的名字，还能认一点字。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: Well, I'll put her in the red group and we can always change her to the green one if there are any problems
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 那我就先把她安排进红色组；如果之后有任何问题，我们随时可以把她调到绿色组。

sentences.en: CAROL: That sounds fine
sentences.zh: CAROL: 这样听起来不错。

sentences.en: DIRECTOR: OK
sentences.zh: DIRECTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: Let's move on to meals
sentences.zh: 我们接着谈谈餐饮安排。

sentences.en: We can provide breakfast, lunch and dinner
sentences.zh: 我们可以提供早餐、午餐和晚餐。

sentences.en: As she's finishing pretty early, she won't need dinner, will you give her breakfast before she comes?
sentences.zh: 由于她放学时间比较早，就不需要晚餐了；您送她来之前会给她吃早餐吗？

sentences.en: CAROL: Yes, she'll only need lunch
sentences.zh: CAROL: 是的，她只需要吃午餐。
